verdict.rationale: Pulumi Policies is a first-party policy-as-code feature: guardrails are defined in code and applied across Pulumi-managed resources, as well as Terraform, CloudFormation and manually created ones. Policy violations surface as pull request comments and checks, and `pulumi preview` evaluates changes without applying them, so the core story is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that mandatory policies block a preview/update before apply (enforcement levels), and independent or hands-on corroboration of blocking behavior.
